title: Wicked: For Good
about: Elphaba and Glinda face the fallout of their choices as the Emerald City turns against the Wicked Witch.
cue: Serve the banquet when the Emerald City celebrates Glinda's engagement.
faces: I'm the Good Witch in name now, Elphie, but you're the one I'd follow. Eat something, you're thin as a broom.

A tray charge applies to every order. Prices subject to change. Every drink is alcohol free. The Scarecrow, the Tin Man and the Lion. Nessarose's ruby slippers. Form RS 425. Images: TMDB.

    StartersMunchkinland cheese tartsMini gruyère and chive custard tarts baked until puffedHow to make it2 sheets of shortcrust pastry3 eggs200ml thickened cream80g gruyère1 bunch chivesLine a 12-hole tray with rounds cut from the shortcrust pastry.Whisk the eggs with the cream, the grated gruyère and snipped chives, pour into the cases and bake at 180°C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.Glinda's bubble strawberry cream puffsGlinda arriving by bubbleHow to make itAs written, serves 4Light choux puffs baked hollow and crisp, filled with pink strawberry whipped cream and dusted with icing sugar and edible glitter like floating bubbles.Heat the oven to 200°C.Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it pulls away from the pan and cool 5 minutes.Beat in 4 eggs one at a time.Pipe 24 rounds onto lined trays and bake 25 minutes, then pierce each and dry in the turned-off oven for 10 minutes.Blitz 150g strawberries with 2 tbsp icing sugar, fold into 300ml whipped cream and pipe into the cooled puffs.Dust with icing sugar.Spinach and gruyère puff pastry twistsGlinda's engagement party, before Fiyero runs.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsEngagement banquet roast chickenTarragon lemon butter roast chicken with potatoes and green beansHow to make it60g butter1 bunch tarragon1 lemon1.8kg whole chicken800g potatoes300g green beansPush the butter mixed with chopped tarragon and lemon zest under the skin of the chicken.Roast at 200°C for 75 minutes with the potatoes in chunks around it.Steam the green beans and toss in the pan juices.Kiamo Ko spiced lamb with green couscousKiamo Ko, Elphaba's castle out in Winkie CountryHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb shoulder rubbed with smoked paprika and cumin, slow roasted until it pulls apart, over a bright green herb couscous with pomegranate and minted yoghurt.Heat the oven to 160°C.Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 2 tbsp oil, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp cumin, 3 crushed garlic cloves and salt.Put in a tin with 250ml water, cover tightly with foil and roast 4 hours until it pulls apart.Pour 300ml boiling stock over 300g couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff.Blitz parsley, coriander and mint with lemon juice and 4 tbsp oil and stir through until green.Top with pomegranate seeds and mint yoghurt.SweetsNessarose's jewelled shoe raspberry tartsSweet pastry cases with vanilla custard and glazed raspberriesHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry3 tbsp custard powder2 tbsp caster sugar500ml milk250g raspberries2 tbsp raspberry jamBake the small tart cases cut from the sweet shortcrust at 180°C for 12 minutes.Make custard from the custard powder, the sugar and the milk, cool and fill the cases.Top with the raspberries brushed with warm raspberry jam.Pistachio shortbread cookiesButtery pistachio shortbread rounds dusted with icing sugarHow to make it100g pistachios150g butter80g icing sugar180g plain flourBlitz the pistachios fine.Beat the butter with the icing sugar, then mix in the flour and the pistachios.Roll into a log, chill 30 minutes, slice into rounds and bake at 160°C for 15 minutes.Dust with icing sugar.DrinksGlinda's bubble emerald mint fizzMuddled mint, lime and sugar topped with soda waterHow to make it1 bunch mint3 limes3 tbsp caster sugar1 L soda waterMuddle a handful of mint leaves with the juice of the limes and the sugar in a jug.Add ice and top with the soda water, stir and pour into glasses with a mint sprig.
